Hello Kalyani,

I saw your opening for a Junior Graphic Designer at MediaClans, and I am drawn to your work building brands across Indian and international markets.

At Ascent Business Solutions, I have produced over 100 digital and print creatives while building reusable design systems that cut turnaround times. I focus on clear visual communication and reliable execution across print and digital media.

For a sense of my brand identity work, you can look at the branding kit for AT Creation startup in my portfolio, which demonstrates direct execution of visual systems: https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/

I would love to share my resume and discuss how I can contribute to your creative team. Do you have ten minutes this week for a brief chat?

Ananya

For a sense of my brand identity work, my AT Creation startup branding kit demonstrates how I design logos, typography systems, and color palettes from scratch. You can review my full portfolio at https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/.

Ananya
